item.title: Advocates push to bolster services for people with disabilities - Greenfield Recorder
item.description: Advocates for people with disabilities traveled to the State House on March 11 to voice their support for legislation to improve care for those with intellectual and developmental disabilities, and to ensure that federal funding cuts do not negatively impact the services and supports available to them.

item.title: Investigators believe Millers Falls fire originated with electrical appliances - Greenfield Recorder
item.description: Element Brewing Co. is hosting a fundraiser on March 27 to raise money for three people displaced by a fire on East Main Street in Millers Falls last week.

item.title: Mohawk Trail, Greenfield students spearhead anti-ICE march - Greenfield Recorder
item.description: Students from Mohawk Trail Regional and Greenfield High School marched from Energy Park to the Greenfield Common to protest ICE violence and encourage young people to speak up for what they believe in.
